notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Lurking Roper using Temple Elder's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
